name: ai-app-chassis
description: Runtime chassis for LLM-backed apps: a Python core library and a FastAPI app template, built with ai-harness-framework.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e && npm run verify-all && npm run quality
scripts.lint: node scripts/framework-check.mjs lint && node tools/py.mjs -m ruff check core template/backend && node tools/py.mjs -m ruff format --check core template/backend
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/framework-check.mjs typecheck && node tools/py.mjs -m mypy --config-file core/pyproject.toml core/src && node tools/py.mjs -m mypy --config-file template/backend/pyproject.toml template/backend/src
scripts.test: node scripts/framework-check.mjs test && node tools/py.mjs -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider core/tests template/backend/tests
scripts.build: node scripts/framework-check.mjs build && node tools/py.mjs -m compileall -q core/src template/backend/src
scripts.vcr: npm run check && npm run check-arch && node scripts/framework-check.mjs record-trail vcr
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run check-arch
